summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a management proposal for an extraordinary general meeting to approve the merger of Esfera Fidelidade S.A. into the company. The filing includes an appraisal report by PricewaterhouseCoopers and a protocol of merger. No financial terms, share prices, or premium are disclosed. The meeting is scheduled for June 30, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing regarding an internal merger, not a special situation such as a going-private transaction or spin-off to external shareholders.
